title: Raw diag server-side MUSTs unenforced: no PHY/regulatory rejection, no admin/OSCORE gate (spec 17.5.4)
description: spec/11-lci.md 17.5.4: raw TX MUST reject frames/overrides violating configured PHY/regulatory constraints (R-11-028); raw diagnostics MUST require local administrative authorization (R-11-030); beyond-local exposure MUST use OSCORE or equivalent (R-11-032). Evidence: Python reference resources /diag/raw/rx + /diag/raw/tx have NO server-side authorization gate (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/raw_rx.py:45 render_put, raw_tx.py:41 render_post; rg is_local_admin|oscore|admin -> zero hits) — authorization is client-side only (python/src/lichen/client/lci.py:240-270 LESC check, bypassable server-side). No PHY/regulatory constraint rejection anywhere: Py caps frame length only (raw_tx.py:51), no radio-override validation surface; C/Rs have no raw TX at all (Rs region TX-power caps are unwired primitives, rust/lichen-hal/src/lib.rs:223-262). No beyond-local mounting guard: Py raw-diag resources are mountable on any UDP site with no OSCORE gate and no build/config signal restricting them. C omits /diag/raw entirely (spec-sanctioned MAY) so the gap binds the Python reference server and any future C/Rs implementer. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/raw_rx.py + raw_tx.py, wiring coap/access.py Admin gate + OSCORE/beyond-local guard; mirror in C when /diag/raw lands. Refs R-11-028, R-11-030, R-11-032 in docs/spec-coverage.md (spec/11-lci.md sweep).
